title: (RHBA-2020:2685) container-selinux bug fix update
portal_summary: An updated container-selinux package that fixes one bug is now available for Red Hat Enterprise Linux 7 extras.
portal_product_filter: Red Hat Enterprise Linux|Red Hat Enterprise Linux Server|7|x86_64
Red Hat Enterprise Linux|Red Hat Enterprise Linux Workstation|7|x86_64
Red Hat Enterprise Linux|Red Hat Enterprise Linux for IBM z Systems|7|s390x
Red Hat Enterprise Linux|Red Hat Enterprise Linux for Power, little endian|7|ppc64le
portal_solution:
Before applying this update, make sure all previously released errata relevant to your system have been applied.

For details on how to apply this update, refer to:

https://access.redhat.com/articles/11258
portal_description:
The container-selinux package provides SELinux policies for container runtimes.

Users of container-selinux are advised to upgrade to this updated package, which fixes one bug.
